description: Deterministic, data-only rules for brand-scale enrichment: inventory flags, research batching, coverage classification and model research status. Nothing here is a vehicle fact; it only decides ordering and labels. No clocks, no randomness.

few_rows.doc: fewer than this many strict spec rows resolve to the model

no_recent_years.doc: newest legacy model year (year_from or stated year_end) is below this, or the model has no rows

few_trims.doc: fewer than this many trims in car_catalog.json trimsByBrandModel

missing_dimensions.doc: a core dimension with zero values in the strict legacy rows

inventory.sparse_if: any of the sparse flags is raised

batching.balanced: n_batches = ceil(n_models / target); the first (n_models % n_batches) batches get one extra model so sizes differ by at most one. No model is ever dropped.

priority.doc: score = w_sparse*sparse_flag_count_capped + w_recent*is_recent + w_presence*has_presence. Higher score first; ties: more catalog trims first, then canonical name (casefold). Every model gets a batch; older models are scheduled last, never deleted.
priority.presence: model has >=1 strict spec row OR >=1 catalog trim

classes.CONFLICT: an unresolved conflict touches this dimension (fields in enrichment_lib.DIM_CONFLICT_FIELDS)
classes.NO_EVIDENCE: no VERIFIED, no NEEDS_SOURCE_RETRIEVAL and no PROVISIONAL value
classes.PARTIAL: values exist but none (or too little) is integrity-verified: NEEDS_SOURCE_RETRIEVAL / PROVISIONAL only, OR VERIFIED by a single source in a single market/generation scope
classes.GOOD: at least one VERIFIED value AND the integrity-verified records (tier 1-3, preserved snapshot, quote found) span >=2 distinct sources OR >=2 distinct market/generation scopes

coverage.note: Research coverage describes the EVIDENCE COLLECTED, not whether the model is complete. It is never a numeric confidence score. Snippet-only (or otherwise unvalidated) evidence never makes a dimension GOOD.

rules: no evidence file or zero records -> NOT_STARTED

RESEARCHED: >= 5 of 8 coverage dimensions GOOD (GOOD itself needs integrity-verified evidence), NO coverage dimension is NO_EVIDENCE (all 8 have at least some evidence, validated or not), and at least one tier 1-3 record passes the integrity test (FULL_TEXT_VERIFIED / PDF_VERIFIED, quote found in the preserved snapshot)
PARTIALLY_RESEARCHED: at least 3 dimensions have VERIFIED (integrity-verified) values
otherwise -> NEEDS_MORE_SOURCES (including models whose tier 1-3 evidence is snippet-only or unpreserved)
model_status.disclaimer: RESEARCHED means the minimum evidence thresholds were met for the markets/generations listed in the evidence file 'coverage' statement. It does not claim every historical global configuration was found.

rules: some but not all models started -> IN_PROGRESS
every model started -> RESEARCHED_PENDING_REVIEW (still UNREVIEWED; never 'complete')
